stories.title: Tearful Pochettino says United job was ‘difficult to turn down’ in USMNT farewell
summary: Coach was ‘transparent’ in dealings with club, federationPochettino had signed deal to stay with US through 2030There were always going to be tears at Mauricio Pochettino’s news conference at US Soccer’s national training center on Friday.

Pochettino is famously emotional, and nobody in attendance had to wait long for the waterworks – they came during his introductory remarks, as he thanked the US Soccer executives flanking him for the opportunity to guide the US men.

He grew emotional again as he addressed his impending departure for Manchester United, one announced just hours earlier.“I think [the decision was],” Pochettino said, pausing to compose himself, “one of the most difficult decisions of our careers.

summary: Neither side have lost in the league yet but a more competitive division should take title race to the wireThere was a time when the games between the top three – traditionally Chelsea, Manchester City and Arsenal – were title-deciders.

summary: That puts them dangerously close to the NFL record of five within a single season (a record shared by the 1984 Bears and 2023 Browns when excluding the 1987 strike season).Jackson, Huntley and Fagnano were all injured after taking hits in games.
And if it seems like quarterbacks are taking punishment more often this year, your eyes aren’t deceiving you.
